newsitem.title: USA: Martin Color-Fi sees improved 97 sales, net.
newsitem.headline: Martin Color-Fi sees improved 97 sales, net.

text.p: Martin Color-Fi Inc said Friday its sales and earnings will continue to improve this year.

"Results for the second quarter and first half of 1997 reflect a solid performance," said Chief Executive James Martin in a statement. "Sales of the Fibers Division's new Colorfine polyester production line have been increasing gradually. We continue to expect improved sales and earnings for 1997," he said.
Earnings for the second quarter and six months ended June 29.
The company said second quarter net income was $1.3 million, or $0.20 a share, compared with net income of $932,000, or $0.14 a share, for the year-earlier period.
Net sales increased 9.5 percent to $32.3 million.
Martin Color-Fi produces polyester fibers from recycled plastic.
